ui.doneText: Every item is ticked. What next?

onboarding.title: Write it like a note
onboarding.text: Tap “New list” and start typing. Use B for bold, ☑ for a checkbox line and •≡ for bullets. Press Enter after a checkbox to add the next one.

onboarding.title: Your lists become strips
onboarding.text: Each list is a narrow strip. Hover or tap one to open it, then tick items off. Ticked items drop to the bottom and the strip fills up like a progress bar. The pencil edits and the bin deletes.

onboarding.title: Finish it or run it again
onboarding.text: Tick every checkbox, then Repeat the list or Resolve it to the Resolved tab. Active lists also start fresh on their own every new day.
